newsitem.title: GERMANY: Five children, youths injured in Berlin explosion.
newsitem.headline: Five children, youths injured in Berlin explosion.

text.p: Five children and youths were injured, one of them seriously, on Sunday in an explosion in a yard attached to apartment buildings in central Berlin, a police spokesman said.
He said it was not yet known what had caused the blast.
A Reuters photographer at the scene said police had sealed off the area and an ambulance was standing outside one entrance to the yard.
Unexploded bombs left over from World War Two are still occasionally found in Germany, but police did not know if one had caused the explosion and had no more immediate details about the blast.
